summary: Re-review after the light-touch declutter (logs/clutter_audit_2026-11-21_b.json, level_17 entry). Both edits landed exactly as the audit wrote them, and nothing else changed. Cyrus's script[12] is now 'Every topping' is how my worst evenings start. The crushed peanuts always end up right next to the sprinkles.' It's still dry, deliberate and certain, so it reads as Cyrus without the lecture. The peanut trap is still fair in buried style: Cyrus's line and Maya's satay_incident line ([13]) both come out of Roxy's 'every topping' craving mid-conversation, and Lantern Pier's review 2 plainly shows peanuts roasted in the back, the peanut-butter swirl churned in the shared machine and crushed peanuts on the topping tray. So the player can rule the venue out from the reviews alone, and the cut spoon and tub detail isn't needed. The trimmed line still names the topping tray and answers Roxy's 'every topping', so Roxy's 'toppings were MY idea' outcome line has its setup. Cyrus's Lantern Pier outcome line now describes only what he sees at the venue, consistent with its review, and no longer points back to a chat explanation that's gone. The clue map, buried placement and every other trap are unchanged. No new problems.
